title: Dummy Training

steps.prompt: A combat training dummy: a wooden post with a straw-stuffed burlap torso and head, two short wooden arms, a dented old pot helmet, a painted red target on the chest, on a wooden cross base. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 8000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 1.80 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/concepts/con_dummy_training.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=39625 final_tris=7999 dims=1.022x0.662x1.800 tex=2048. Made with TRELLIS.2. Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
